/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3.12 -c 'from solution import patch_query
cases = [
(\"preserve fragment\", \"https://example.invalid/p?a=1#section\", [], \"https://example.invalid/p?a=1#section\"),
(\"duplicates and blanks\", \"/p?a=1&a=2&blank=&z=3\", [], \"/p?a=1&a=2&blank=&z=3\"),
(\"replacement moves to end\", \"/p?a=1&b=2&a=3\", [(\"a\",\"4\")], \"/p?b=2&a=4\"),
(\"empty string value\", \"/p?a=1\", [(\"a\",\"\")], \"/p?a=\"),
(\"literal text encoding\", \"/p\", [(\"a&b\",\"雪 +%=&\")], \"/p?a%26b=%E9%9B%AA+%2B%25%3D%26\"),
(\"decoded key and case sensitivity\", \"/p?%61=1&A=2&z=3\", [(\"a\",\"4\")], \"/p?A=2&z=3&a=4\"),
(\"left to right generator\", \"/p?a=1&b=2\", iter([(\"a\",\"3\"),(\"b\",None),(\"a\",\"4\")]), \"/p?a=4\"),
]
for name,url,updates,expected in cases:
    actual=patch_query(url,updates)
    status=\"PASS\" if actual == expected else \"FAIL\"
    print(f\"{status}: {name}: actual={actual"'!r}; expected={expected!r}")
updates=[("a","2"),("b",None)]
before=updates.copy()
patch_query("/p?a=1",updates)
print("PASS: updates unchanged" if updates == before else "FAIL: updates changed")'"'"
